title: CI and build upkeep
description: Bump actions/checkout and actions/setup-python to Node 24 versions; align ruff scope between CI ('.') and the Docker test stage ('app tests'); add HEALTHCHECK --start-period; pin transitive deps (constraints or lock file) so home-ai builds don't drift.

title: Go live on home-ai (Part 1 Task 15 steps 4-6)
description: Copy ops/install-on-home-ai.sh to home-ai, run 'key', Bob adds READ-ONLY deploy key at github.com/BobTheGeek/kitchen-dashboard/settings/keys, run 'install' from a console/Screen Sharing session (launchctl gui domain). Before install: check container uid 10001 can write the bind mount: docker run --rm --user 10001 -v ~/household-ai/data/dashboard:/data python:3.13-slim touch /data/.w (fallback: user 501:20 in compose). Then verify /api/version, push a trivial commit to see the watcher deploy, and get a photo of the kiosk.

title: Multi-day all-day events: show on every day they cover
description: build_week puts an all-day event only on its start date, and drops it entirely if it started before today (e.g. Grandma visiting Sat-Tue vanishes on Mon). Expand over [start, end) clipped to the week. Also parse all-day dates with date.fromisoformat instead of start[:10], once calendar-api's real all-day format is confirmed. Ask Bob how multi-day chips should look.

title: API: allow slashes in event uid and calendar name routes
description: DELETE /api/events/{uid} and PUT /api/settings/calendars/{name} 404 when the value contains '/', because Starlette decodes %2F before routing. Use {uid:path} and {name:path} and add tests.

title: Deploy script hygiene
description: deploy.sh exits 0 when the lock is held, the fetch failed, or origin/main is a known-bad SHA: make manual runs exit non-zero and document deleting ~/.kitchen-deploy.failed to retry. Prune old household/kitchen-dashboard:<sha> images and rotate kitchen-deploy.log. install script: anchor 'Host github-kitchen' grep, retry after launchctl bootout, mkdir ~/.ssh. Consider replacing hardcoded /Users/bobg in the plist.

title: Small UI polish
description: Add <link rel=icon href=data:,> (favicon 404) and mobile-web-app-capable meta; status line shows hours/days past 60 min instead of '1440 min ago'; TODO delete failure toast says 'save'; night mode fades in ~1s after a cold load at night; deploy-time reload can wipe a phone form being typed.

title: calendar-api cannot reach iCloud (AuthorizationError)
description: Every calendar-api call returns 502 'Couldn't reach iCloud calendars: AuthorizationError' (seen 2026-10-26). Likely an expired/revoked app-specific password. Fix lives in the household-ai repo (Bob). Dashboard shows 'no calendar data yet' until fixed.
close_reason: Resolved: on 2026-10-27 calendar-api returns live data (calendar_ok true, Family + Benny Time events).

title: Test gaps
description: todos: order among several done items, exact-minute overdue boundary, get() None, created_by default. settings: assert the change counter bumps on each write. labels: noon and 00:00. Update the spec's /api/week field list to fetched_at + calendar_ok (code is the source of truth).

title: Part 2: Talk to the house
description: Voice/chat panel (designs 2b, 5a-5d, 8g, 8e, phone 4d), local speech-to-text on home-ai (no browser Web Speech API), House AI tools to add events (calendar-api POST/PATCH) and TODOs (POST /api/todos created_by=house), HTTPS on the kiosk via Tailscale certs (approved). Needs its own brainstorm/spec; touches Open WebUI and household-ai.

title: Phone robustness fixes
description: phone.js: disable Add while the POST is in flight (double tap creates duplicates); addDefaults date falls back to today if the week has not loaded; clear view.sheet when its sheet renders empty (stuck sheet + no refresh); null guards in findTodo/findEvent/formFail/famFail; pickdate re-renders on both input and change.

title: Part 3: Idle photo slideshow
description: Shared Apple Photos album synced on home-ai (Photos app + osxphotos export to ~/household-ai/data/photos hourly; home-ai not signed in to iCloud yet; test osxphotos shared-album support). Designs 7a, 7c. Needs its own spec.

title: Calendar client hardening: backoff, tests, corrupt cache
description: app/calendar.py: add a short negative cache (~60s) after a calendar-api failure so polls don't each wait up to the 15s timeout; add HttpSource tests (URL/query, uid quoting, HTTPError and 502 mapping); guard against a corrupt calendar_cache row in _stale(); treat naive ISO times as Chicago.
